feedback.problem:
Let
$E=[\begin{aligned}-1 & 2 \\ 4 & 0 \\ 3 & 5 \\ 7 & -6\end{aligned}]$
and
$F=[\begin{aligned}9 & -2 & 8 & 1 \\ -4 & 6 & 0 & -3\end{aligned}].$
Then, the dimensions of $FE$ are{{field-1}}$\times $
{{field-2}}.
feedback.worked_solution:
We notice that $E$ is a $4\times 2$ matrix and $F$ is a $2\times 4$ matrix. 

There are $4$ columns in $F$ and $4$ rows in $E.$ Since the number of columns in $F$ equals the number of rows in $E,$ the matrices $F$ and $E$ are conformable for multiplication. 

The product $FE$ has dimensions $2\times 2:$

$$
{F}_{2\times \boxed{\text{4}}}{\times }_{✓}{E}_{\boxed{\text{4}}\times 2}={FE}_{2\times 2}
$$
